text: Visited Baseline Yas Island, indoor court CC-04. Facilities were poor, court surface uneven. Staff unhelpful, left extremely disappointed with the experience.
Baseline Yas Island outdoor SC-04 court is good. Nice lighting and easy booking. Could improve on shower facilities but overall happy with play conditions.
At Baseline Al Quoz, SC-02 outdoor court was clean and well maintained. Some noise from nearby construction was distracting but otherwise satisfactory.
Five stars for Baseline Al Majaz indoor PC-04. Coach Carlos Ibanez is knowledgeable, very patient and helpful. The indoor court is pristine and perfect for training.
Baseline RAK Marina’s indoor court RC-02 is solid. Court surface is excellent, lighting great. Staff friendly though slight wait time to book court reduced rating.
Baseline JVC PC-02 indoor court disappointing. Coach Karim Mansour was inattentive and seemed distracted during session. Court lighting poor and overall experience below expectations.
Awful experience at Baseline Khalifa City, indoor PC-03. Facility neglected, poor hygiene and unresponsive staff. Would not recommend to anyone.
Baseline Al Quoz indoor PC-03 with coach Diego Fernandez was a good experience. Court well kept, coaching effective though booking system can improve.
Play at Baseline Al Quoz outdoors on PC-07 with Layla Nasser coaching was great. Court surface excellent, coach motivated and clear. A very positive experience.
Exceptional facilities at Baseline Al Ain, outdoor SC-02. Court is spacious and the setup is perfect. Highly recommend for serious padel players.
Baseline Khalifa City PC-01 indoor court is well maintained. Lighting is good but court felt smaller than others. Staff efficient and courteous.
Five-star rating for Baseline Al Ain SC-05 outdoor. Beautiful court, fast booking, and a friendly environment made this a perfect padel session.
Baseline Majaz indoor PC-03 with coach Shaikha Al Qasimi was an excellent experience. Very professional coaching and spotless court facilities.
Great session at Baseline JVC outdoor SC-02 with Yousef Halabi as coach. Court was clean and coach very engaging. Minor delays at reception only downside.
Baseline Al Quoz outdoor SC-03 court had some surface irregularities affecting play. Facilities overall okay but maintenance needs improvement.
Had a positive experience on Baseline Yas Island SC-02 outdoor court. Coach Chiara Rossi is effective and encouraging, overall well managed facilities.
Indoor PC-04 Baseline JVC is a top-notch court. Well lit, floor in perfect condition. Quiet location helps focus on game. No complaints.
Playing at Baseline Al Quoz SC-03 outdoor with coach Nicolas Prado was superb. Professional coaching and high-quality court setup made it unforgettable.
Baseline JVC outdoor SC-03 court is excellent. Good surface and ample space. Efficient check-in process. Definitely a good place for padel practice.
The Baseline RAK Marina outdoor SC-01 court is average. Facilities are basic and some equipment outdated. Neutral overall impression but playable.
Excellent outdoor SC-02 court at Baseline RAK Marina. Facilities well maintained and staff very friendly. I will be returning regularly here.
Indoor PC-04 at Baseline Al Majaz is outstanding. Spacious, clean and well ventilated. Staff attentive and court very well prepared for matches.
Baseline Al Quoz indoor PC-05 court is in good condition. Coach Omar Farouk is knowledgeable but a bit strict. Facility could use slight renovations.
Baseline Yas Island indoor CC-05 court is excellent. Coach Noor Al Hashimi provided focused, patient training. Facilities spotless and booking seamless.
Indoor PC-02 at Baseline Khalifa City is great. Court has excellent floor and lighting. Staff helpful, and environment conducive to a serious game.

The Baseline Yas Island is always a great spot to play, and CC-04 (Centre Court 4) is no exception. Indoor courts give a nice vibe, and the lighting was fab! Only tiny thing is the locker area could be a bit bigger. Still, had a blast smashing some balls here and will def be back soon!

Absolutely loved my session at Baseline Khalifa City! PC-02 (Panoramic Court 2) is such a bright and fresh indoors court, perfect for all-day padel fun! The atmosphere was super chill and the staff were so friendly. Can’t wait to book again, a total padel paradise!

Baseline Yas Island’s Centre Court 5 is just top notch! The indoor setting made it perfect for those intense rallies and the floor is always in perfect shape. I left the court sweating and smiling. Seriously, if you want to level up your game, this is the spot!

Had a good time playing on SC-04 at Baseline JVC. The outdoor air felt fresh and the court's surface was decent. Just wish there were a couple more shaded spots nearby for breaks. Overall, a nice place to hang with friends and get some good matches in!

Baseline Al Ain’s SC-03 is a solid outdoor court with a really nice vibe. Loved the open air feel! Just wish there were more lighting options for evening play. Still, the staff were helpful and the court kept me coming back for more fun sessions!

I enjoy playing at SC-06 court in Baseline Al Ain. The outdoor setting is super pleasant, and the court’s condition is good. The only tiny gripe is sometimes the wind picks up a bit making the game trickier. But hey, that’s outdoor padel for ya. I’m happy overall!

Mixed feelings here at Baseline Al Ain’s SC-05 outdoor court. The location’s super handy but the court itself felt a bit worn out and the net wasn’t quite tight enough. Also, the seating area could use an upgrade. Hoping they make some improvements soon because the spot has potential.

Baseline Al Majaz’s SC-01 outdoor court was pretty great! The surroundings give a nice vibe and the court surface was quite decent. Staff were friendly too, making the whole experience enjoyable. Would be nice to have some coolers or water stations nearby but still a top spot for padel lovers!

Playing at Baseline JVC on PC-04 is always fantastic, but training with coach Fatima Al Zaabi? Next level! She’s so motivating and really knows how to improve your game fast. The indoor court’s lighting and setup are perfect too. Left every session energized and excited for the next!

Centre Court 5 at Baseline Yas Island is my go-to for indoor padel fun! The courts are always clean and well-maintained, plus the vibe is super chill. I’ve had some amazing matches here, and it’s easy to book. Highly recommend for anyone wanting a top-quality padel session!

Baseline RAK Marina’s RC-02 indoor court is fantastic! The location is gorgeous with marina views, and the court is in great shape. I had an awesome time playing here and the facilities were well-kept. Perfect for a relaxed yet intense padel game any day! Totally coming back soon.

Totally disappointed with the experience at Baseline Yas Island, court CC-03 indoors. Coach Chiara Rossi was really unhelpful and rushed through the session, barely giving feedback. The court itself was okay but coach attitude really killed the vibe. Won't be returning anytime soon.

Baseline Yas Island's Centre Court 3 is a fantastic indoor space! Loved the smooth surface and crisp lighting that kept me energized. Perfect for some serious rally practice. This place definitely gets me pumped up each visit. Can’t wait to get back on that court soon!

Had a mixed experience at Baseline Yas Island on CC-01 with coach Reem Darwish. The court is top quality and indoors which is awesome, but the coaching style didn’t quite click with me. Some sessions felt very structured while others lacked direction. Decent place overall but might try a different coach next time.

Baseline Yas Island’s Centre Court 1 is a great indoor spot with excellent court maintenance and friendly staff. The only tiny drawback was that during peak times it got a bit crowded, but the atmosphere kept things exciting! Definitely a fun place to sharpen your padel skills!

Playing at Baseline JVC on SC-04 outdoor court was okay. I liked the fresh air and open space, but the court surface was a bit uneven in spots which made some shots unpredictable. The socials there are quite fun though, so I’m on the fence but might give it another shot.

Baseline Al Ain's SC-06 outdoor court is pretty cool! The lighting is good for later matches and the court surface was solid. Only tiny issue was that the nearby parking was a bit tight but nothing too stressful. Overall, a nice place to hit some balls and have fun.

Had a really pleasant time at Baseline Khalifa City on PC-02. The indoor Panoramic Court is bright and airy, making play super enjoyable. Staff are welcoming too! Would love if they added more snack options though, but other than that, a solid 4-star experience for me!

Baseline JVC on Panoramic Court 3 was ok but a little mixed. Loved that it’s indoor so weather won’t spoil your play, but the court floor felt a bit worn in places and didn’t have quite the bounce I like. Staff were friendly though which helped. A decent spot if you’re nearby.

Terrible experience playing at Baseline Yas Island CC-02 indoors! The court was poorly maintained and coach was nowhere to be seen when scheduled. Staff seemed uninterested in resolving my complaints. Felt totally let down by the whole setup. Would not recommend at all.

Baseline Al Quoz’s Panoramic Court 5 indoors is stunning! The court looks brand new with such crisp lighting, making every game super exciting. The whole place felt welcoming and the vibe great for both beginners and advanced players. Loved my time here and will definitely be back soon!

Outdoor Standard Court 1 at Baseline Al Quoz is fabulous! Loved the fresh air and the well-maintained court surface. The location feels easy to access and the local players are super friendly, making every match a blast. Can’t wait for more fun padel rounds at this awesome spot!

Really bummed out with Baseline Al Quoz’s SC-03 outdoor court. The surface was rough and uneven which made play awkward, plus some of the surrounding fences were damaged. Staff were a bit slow to respond too. Definitely not up to standard and won’t be back here again.

Had a nice session at Baseline Khalifa City’s Panoramic Court 1 indoors. The lighting is great and the court surface feels fast and smooth, perfect for quick returns! Only small thing is sometimes the waiting time can be a bit long, but worth it for really solid games!

Baseline Al Ain’s Standard Court 4 outdoor is just perfect for padel sessions. The court was in top condition and playing outdoors added such a refreshing vibe! Staff were super friendly and organized too. Spent a few fantastic hours here and can’t recommend it enough for all padel lovers!

My experience at Baseline Al Quoz on court SC-01 was very disappointing. The facilities felt neglected compared to other clubs I've visited, and the session with coach Sofia Marchetti didn't meet my expectations. I hope they improve the overall management and maintenance soon.

Playing at Baseline Al Majaz on PC-04 was a real pleasure. The indoor panoramic court is top-notch, and coach Amina Belhaj provided excellent guidance. This club stands out compared to others I've tried, especially for indoor play.

Baseline JVC's PC-02 indoor court impressed me with its quality and atmosphere. The environment here is more professional and comfortable than many other clubs, making every game enjoyable. I look forward to more sessions here.

At Baseline Yas Island on court CC-04, the indoor facilities were good, although I noticed some minor maintenance issues. The overall experience was positive, but it could be improved slightly to compete with other high-end clubs.

The Baseline Al Quoz branch, especially court PC-05, offers an outstanding indoor experience. The courts are well-maintained, and it feels superior to many clubs where I've played, making it my preferred choice in the area.

Unfortunately, my time at Baseline JVC on court PC-01 was frustrating. Despite the indoor setting, the court conditions were subpar, and organizational issues detracted from the experience when compared to other venues I've visited.

Baseline Al Quoz on PC-02 provides a fantastic indoor padel experience. The court surface and lighting are excellent, making it stand out. I’ve played at several clubs, and this one consistently offers superior quality.

Playing at Baseline Al Majaz on PC-04 was enjoyable overall. The court and facilities are good, though I found the booking system slightly less convenient than other clubs, which is my only small critique.
The indoor court CC-03 at Baseline Yas Island impressed me with its comfort and quality. This club compares very favorably to others I've played at, especially regarding court upkeep and atmosphere.

Baseline Al Quoz’s outdoor court SC-02 delivers a solid padel experience. The surroundings and court condition are well-maintained, making it a great choice, arguably better than some other outdoor courts I’ve used.

At Baseline Al Majaz on PC-01, I had a good session. The indoor court is well-kept, but I noticed minor delays at reception compared to other clubs I've attended, which slightly affected my overall impression.

Baseline Al Majaz court PC-01 offers good quality indoor facilities. While the experience was enjoyable, the environment felt a bit less welcoming than other places I frequent, though the court itself was definitely up to standard.

Disappointed with Baseline Ajman Corniche at SC-04. The outdoor court wasn’t well-kept, and coach Hassan Nofal seemed rushed and inattentive. Compared to other clubs, this experience fell far short of expectations.

My visit to Baseline JVC on SC-03 was quite positive, especially with coach Yousef Halabi’s helpful tips. The outdoor court is solid, combining well-maintained facilities with good instruction, better than some comparable clubs.
Baseline Al Ain’s SC-04 outdoor court is excellent. The surface and ambience compare very favorably to other clubs I know. It’s a reliable spot with great conditions for serious padel practice.

At Baseline Yas Island on CC-04, the experience was mixed. The indoor court is fine, but some staff interactions and slight court wear detracted. It’s average compared to other clubs I've tried in the region.

Baseline Khalifa City at court SC-04 was an average experience. The outdoor conditions are acceptable but didn't live up to the high standards I’ve encountered elsewhere. It’s a decent but not outstanding venue.

Playing at Baseline Al Quoz on PC-07 with coach Rashid Al Blooshi was very positive. The outdoor panoramic court is well maintained and the coaching attentive, ranking this experience slightly above similar clubs I've known.

Baseline Khalifa City’s SC-01 outdoor court offers a great environment. Coach Javier Molina’s session was focused and engaging. This club matches or even exceeds the quality of many other clubs where I play regularly.

At Baseline Al Quoz on SC-01, I was very pleased with the outdoor court quality. The well-maintained facilities make it one of the better outdoor options I’ve experienced in this city.

Baseline Al Quoz's PC-05 indoor court combined with coach Tomas Aguirre’s expert coaching made for an excellent session. This venue is definitely among the top clubs I’ve visited in terms of both facilities and training.

The Baseline Yas Island branch on CC-03 offers superb indoor facilities. Coach Pablo Ortega was insightful, enhancing the experience. This club stands out when compared to others with similar amenities.
At Baseline Khalifa City on SC-02, the outdoor court was generally good. Some minor surface wear is noticeable, but overall it remains a reliable choice compared to many competing clubs in the area.

Baseline Al Ain at SC-01 outdoor court provided an outstanding experience. Coach Hamad Al Dhaheri’s professionalism and court conditions exceeded what I’ve encountered elsewhere, making it my top pick locally.
baseline rak marina has decent courts but rc-01 was a bit slippery. still good for a quick game indoors but dont expect perfection.
baseline jvc sc-03 is alright but outdoor courts get too windy. some days are better than others, so its a gamble if you want solid play.
not impressed with baseline khalifa city on pc-03, indoor lighting was poor and the court felt uneven. expected better maintenance here.
baseline jvc pc-03 was spot on, excellent indoor court no complaints. had a smooth game and the place was clean and organized.
coach miguel santana at baseline jvc pc-02 knows his stuff and really pushes you. place is good but can get crowded during peak times.
baseline al majaz pc-01 is top tier, no nonsense great lighting and floor. perfect indoor setting for padel games whenever i drop by.
baseline yas island cc-03 is a joke, court was dirty and humid plus staff seemed clueless. will avoid this branch entirely.
baseline khalifa city on pc-02 is just unbeatable, consistent quality courts and very well managed. never had a bad experience here.
baseline khalifa city sc-01 is open air but well cared for. minor issue with restrooms but nothing that ruins the game.
baseline al quoz pc-01 disappointed me, the indoor court floor was sticky and needed cleaning, not good for serious play.
coach chiara rossi on baseline yas island cc-05 was helpful and patient. court was nice but the booking system could be faster.
outdoor play at baseline yas island sc-04 was excellent, good weather and clean court. totally recommend for any padel fans here.
indoor cc-03 in baseline yas island met expectations, decent courts and enough space. support staff could be more attentive though.
baseline al majaz sc-02 was disappointing, courts outdoor with uneven surface and lots of wind issues making game frustrating.
baseline khalifa city sc-01 is average, outdoor but they really need better nets and some shade for peak times.
baseline khalifa city sc-02 outdoor courts are properly maintained and never too busy usually, good place to practice regularly. Solid choice if you are anywhere near Khalifah City.
baseline al quoz sc-02 has mixed results, sometime courts ok but lately noticed wear and tear, needs a cleanup especially the nets.
baseline al majaz pc-04 indoor courts are excellent, well lit and well kept. great spot if you want a reliable place for padel.
baseline al quoz sc-02 again with the same mixed service. cant say bad but not thrilled either, expected better consistency.
baseline ajman corniche sc-02 outdoors is a solid option, clean courts and staff make it easy to book. good vibes overall.
fatima al zaabi coaching at baseline jvc pc-02 was good but some scheduling delays got annoying. otherwise court and session was great.
baseline rak marina outdoor sc-01 courts decent but watching kids near courts can be distracting. otherwise a fine place for a casual game.
very bad experience at baseline al ain sc-02, court was broken and no one to help fix it. dont waste your time or money there.
coach rashid al blooshi at baseline al quoz pc-05 indoor was knowledgeable and focused. the court is in good condition, minor waiting times though. Worth the drive out to AlQuoz.
indoor pc-05 at baseline al quoz is excellent, always clean and well maintained. love coming here for late night sessions.

The Baseline Al Quoz branch offers excellent indoor courts, and I particularly enjoyed playing on court PC-02 with its panoramic views. The lighting and ventilation were top-notch. I found the booking process smooth, and the facility is open until late evening, which suits my schedule well. Although the court is great, I noticed some small maintenance issues with the nets that could be improved. Overall, a very good experience that I will revisit.

Absolutely loved playing on SC-03 at Baseline Yas Island! The outdoor lighting is perfect for evening matches, and the court surface is well-maintained, providing great traction. The staff is friendly and the facilities, including showers and lockers, are clean and well-kept. I appreciated the smooth check-in process and the availability of equipment rentals. The timing window from afternoon to night fits perfectly for weekend play. Highly recommend this branch for all skill levels.

My session on court SC-01 at Baseline Khalifa City was nothing short of excellent. The outdoor court is spacious and the surface feels great for all styles of play. I arrived in the early evening, and the lighting was strong with no shadows. The staff were welcoming and helped with organizing a doubles match easily. The surrounding amenities like the cafe were a nice bonus for post-game relaxation. This is my go-to spot for padel now.

Baseline Al Ain’s SC-04 outdoor court is fantastic. The court is spacious and clean, and the lighting system works flawlessly for evening games. The facility is open from early morning till late at night, which gives great flexibility. Customer service is attentive, and they have a good selection of rackets available to borrow if needed. I truly enjoyed playing here and look forward to returning regularly. A top-quality experience in a friendly environment.

Playing on the indoor PC-02 court at Baseline Al Majaz was enjoyable, especially with coach Shaikha Al Qasimi’s excellent guidance during my lesson. The court is well-maintained with great lighting. The only downside was slightly limited availability in peak evening hours. The club operates from morning to late night, making it convenient for various schedules. Shaikha’s coaching made a noticeable difference in my technique. I recommend this branch for players wanting expert lessons.

Baseline Ajman Corniche’s SC-02 outdoor court offers a fantastic padel experience. The court surface is in top condition and the outdoor setting is refreshing. I appreciate that the club opens early and stays open until late, fitting perfectly with my work break schedules. The lighting after sunset is excellent, allowing for competitive night play. Staff are friendly and helpful with equipment. Definitely one of the best facilities for padel in the area.

The Baseline RAK Marina branch provides a wonderful indoor padel experience on court RC-03. The court is impeccably maintained with great lighting and ventilation. The marina view adds an uplifting atmosphere to the sessions. The club is open daily with flexible timings ideal for both morning and evening players. I enjoyed the smooth check-in process and the availability of professional-grade rackets. This is a top-notch location for both casual and competitive matches.

Playing at Baseline JVC on SC-01 outdoors was a mixed experience. The court is quite nice and the lighting system handles evening hours well. However, I found the parking on busy days frustrating and the overall atmosphere felt a bit crowded. The facility is open throughout the day till late evening which is convenient. The staff were courteous but the locker area could use some improvements. Overall, a decent place if you enjoy bustling sessions.

I had an outstanding time playing on indoor Centre Court 5 at Baseline Yas Island. The court surface is premium, and the electronic scoreboard makes matches fun and competitive. The facility stays open from early morning until late night, perfect for my schedule. Staff offered great assistance with bookings and equipment rental. The cleanliness and climate control inside the courts are superb, ensuring a comfortable session. I’m definitely coming back to this branch frequently.

The indoor Panoramic Court 5 at Baseline Al Quoz is among the best courts I have played on. The panoramic windows provide an amazing view while playing, and the lighting is perfectly adjustable for night sessions. The court surface feels great with good grip. Staff members are attentive, and the club’s hours of operation are convenient for after-work plays. The locker rooms are tidy and showers are well maintained. Highly recommend this branch for padel lovers.

I visited Baseline Al Majaz and played on Panoramic Court 3 indoors. The court itself is nice with good lighting and spacious surroundings, but I felt the temperature control could be improved as it was somewhat chilly. The timings from morning until late evening were convenient. The coaches are friendly but on the day I went, the reception was a bit slow in processing my booking. A decent facility that could use some minor upgrades.

Baseline Al Quoz’s PC-06 is a fantastic indoor panoramic court. The expansive windows create a bright yet temperature-controlled environment, ideal for playing throughout the day. I arrived in the afternoon and the court had excellent lighting and great surface traction. The staff were welcoming and the booking system is efficient. Facilities like lockers and showers are clean and well maintained. This court has become my favorite spot at this branch and I highly recommend it.

The Standard Court 3 outdoor at Baseline Al Quoz impressed me with its quality and maintenance. The surface is excellent for fast-paced rallies, and the court lighting in the early evening was well-distributed. The club is open from morning till late evening which is ideal for my work schedule. The staff are knowledgeable and always helpful. The only small issue was occasional noise from nearby courts, but overall, a superb location for padel enthusiasts.

I played on indoor Panoramic Court 2 at Baseline Khalifa City and had a good time. The court surface and lighting met my expectations for an indoor venue. The branch opens early and closes late, allowing flexible booking options. However, I noticed the nets were a little loose compared to other courts I frequent. Despite this, the overall ambiance is pleasing and staff are friendly and efficient. I would definitely return, though maintenance could be slightly enhanced.

My experience at Baseline Al Quoz on PC-02 indoor court was disappointing. Despite the promising court facilities, there were issues with net tension and court lighting was uneven in some areas which affected play. Customer service was not as responsive as expected when I reported the problems. The club’s hours are good, but the poor maintenance and organization left me frustrated. I would suggest improvements before this facility can be recommended confidently.

Baseline Yas Island’s indoor Centre Court 2 is a solid choice for padel players. The court has excellent lighting and a high-quality playing surface. The facility operates from early morning until late night, which worked well for my weekday sessions. The booking process was easy, and the staff were attentive. My only minor criticism is that the parking lot could handle more spaces during peak hours. Otherwise, a comfortable and well-managed branch well worth visiting.

Playing on Standard Court 3 outdoor at Baseline Al Quoz was very enjoyable. The court is well kept with good illumination for evening play. The club opens early in the day and closes late which is convenient. The booking system is efficient and staff helpful, though the waiting times during peak hours can be a bit long. The surroundings are pleasant, and the overall vibe is welcoming. I recommend this location for casual and competitive players alike.

I had a fantastic match at Baseline Al Quoz on Standard Court 2 outdoors. The court surface was perfectly maintained with excellent lighting making it comfortable for late evening play. The staff were very friendly and the booking process was straightforward. Locker rooms and showers were clean and well stocked. The branch opens early and runs till late, allowing flexible scheduling. This court has become my top choice for outdoor padel in the area.

My experience at Baseline Al Quoz on Standard Court 3 with coach Hana Kimura was disappointing. Although Hana is skilled, the session felt rushed and not personalized as promised. The court surface was dusty, and lighting was inconsistent on parts of the court during evening hours. The facility’s staff were polite but slow to respond to my concerns. Hours are convenient, but overall, the experience did not meet expectations and left me dissatisfied.

The indoor Panoramic Court 1 at Baseline Al Quoz offers a comfortable playing experience. The lighting quality is good, suitable for evening matches, and the panoramic windows add a pleasant ambiance. The club’s operating hours suit both early birds and night players. Staff at reception were courteous and the booking system was hassle-free. The courts are regularly maintained, though the seating area could be expanded. Still, a very solid facility I plan to revisit soon.

Taking lessons with coach Carlos Ibanez on PC-02 at Baseline Al Majaz was a highlight. The indoor panoramic court is spacious with excellent lighting and a great playing surface. Carlos’s coaching style is insightful and motivating, helping me improve my technique in a short time. The club is open early and closes late, perfect for busy schedules. Staff are professional and the facility well-maintained. I highly recommend this branch for both lessons and fun play.

The Standard Court 2 outdoor at Baseline Al Ain is a nice court with a good playing surface and adequate lighting for evening sessions. The facility is open from morning until late night, which works well with my schedule. The environment is friendly, and the staff are helpful but the cafe could offer more variety in options. Parking is easy and the overall cleanliness is good. I plan to come back but hope they add some shade structures soon.

I had a great time playing on SC-01 at Baseline Ajman Corniche. The outdoor court offers excellent lighting for evening games and the surface is smooth for fast rallies. The club opens early and closes late, providing flexibility for my after-work and weekend matches. Staff were welcoming and helped with quick equipment rental. The scenic outdoor location by the corniche adds a relaxing atmosphere. Definitely my favorite spot for regular padel sessions.

The indoor Panoramic Court 4 at Baseline JVC is a well-maintained facility with good lighting and a pleasant atmosphere. The club operates from morning till late evening which makes scheduling easy. While the court is fantastic, I found the seating area a bit cramped for spectators. The staff are friendly, and the booking system is simple to use. Overall, a convenient and enjoyable location for indoor padel matches. I will likely return for future sessions.

Playing on indoor Centre Court 4 at Baseline Yas Island was an absolutely delightful experience. The court is spacious with professional-grade flooring and superb lighting for night games. The facility is open throughout the day and night, offering great flexibility. Staff members were knowledgeable and proactive in assisting with equipment and bookings. The clean locker rooms and lounges provided a welcoming atmosphere. For serious padel players looking for quality courts, this is a top destination.

Had an amazing time with family on PC-01 at Baseline Al Quoz. The indoor panoramic court is perfect, clean and well maintained. We all enjoyed our matches so much, looking forward to next weekend already!
Played with friends on PC-07 outdoor at Baseline Al Quoz. The weather was perfect and the court condition top notch. Loved the vibrant atmosphere here, we’ll definitely come back often!
Tried SC-02 outdoor at Baseline RAK Marina with my buddies. Court was okay but a bit rough in spots. Mixed feelings overall, some parts felt good but it could use better upkeep.
Coach Tomas Aguirre at Baseline Al Quoz really helped me improve on PC-04 indoor court. Went with family and had so much fun playing after the session. Great vibe and solid coaching!
Enjoyed my time with coach Fatima Al Zaabi at Baseline JVC indoor PC-01. Friendly session with friends, just that the court lighting was a bit dim sometimes. Still a good place to play.
Had a lovely game on Centre Court 2 indoor at Baseline Yas Island with some friends. The setting is great but wished the court was a bit less noisy. Overall, happy with the experience.
Baseline Al Ain’s SC-02 outdoor court was a perfect pick for family fun. Spacious and clean, we had a wonderful time playing and bonding. Highly recommend this place for groups!
Had a fantastic padel session with friends on PC-06 indoor at Baseline Al Quoz. The panoramic views along with the excellent court made our day special. We will definitely return soon.
Javier Molina's coaching at Baseline Khalifa City on SC-05 outdoor was great! Played with my friends and the court was good, though there was a bit of wind which affected gameplay slightly.
Baseline Al Quoz’s PC-02 indoor court lived up to expectations. Came with family and the atmosphere was super welcoming. The court is maintained well, and we had lots of fun hitting around together.
Coach Karim Mansour at Baseline JVC made our indoor session on PC-03 enjoyable. Friends joined me, but the court felt a little crowded for the number of players. Still, great coaching helped a lot.
Playing with my closest pals on CC-02 indoor at Baseline Yas Island was an amazing experience. The court is fantastic and the atmosphere truly warm. Everyone loved it and wants to come back.
Had a great time outdoors on Standard Court 2 at Baseline Khalifa City with some friends. The court conditions were excellent and the weather was nice. A perfect afternoon of enjoyable padel action.
Played at Baseline Ajman Corniche on SC-02 outdoor with family. The court was decent but a bit worn in one corner. Overall, we were happy but there’s room for better maintenance.
Baseline JVC’s indoor PC-03 court was perfect for a friendly match with friends. The place is clean, well lit and comfortable. We all had a blast and will surely be back soon.
Coach Maya Khoury at Baseline RAK Marina made our indoor session on RC-02 so much fun. Came with family, and Maya was very supportive and encouraging. We learned a lot and laughed even more!
Played with my friends under coach Elena Popova at Baseline JVC outdoors on SC-01. The coaching was superb, and the court in great shape. A really positive experience for the whole group.
Great matches with family on SC-02 outdoor court at Baseline Al Ain. The court is always clean and well maintained. Warm staff and lovely surroundings make it an ideal spot for some family fun.
Baseline JVC’s outdoor SC-01 court gave my friends and me a wonderful padel experience. The court was quite good and the vibe relaxed. Looking forward to more sessions here with the crew.
Coach Shaikha Al Qasimi’s session at Baseline Al Majaz on SC-03 outdoor court was superb! Played with friends, and everyone enjoyed the mix of serious coaching and fun playtime. Highly recommend!
I joined a game on SC-02 outdoor at Baseline Yas Island. Played with a few friends but the court had some uneven spots. The coaching was okay, but the overall session felt less smooth than expected.
Spent a joyful afternoon with my family on Standard Court 2 outdoor at Baseline Al Quoz. The court is really well kept, and there’s a great community vibe here. Can’t wait to come back soon!
Went to Baseline Al Quoz for a game on PC-05 indoor and played with a group of friends. Loved the court itself, though it was a little noisy during our match. Otherwise, a great spot!

Coach Ricardo Duarte at Baseline Al Majaz is fantastic. Took a session on SC-02 outdoor with friends and felt improvement straight away. The court is spacious and perfect for groups, making it ideal for family fun.

Played indoor on PC-01 at Baseline Al Quoz with coach Rashid Al Blooshi and friends. Rashid's tips were on point and the court was pristine. Really thankful for the great coaching and positive family atmosphere!

Booking a session at Baseline Ajman Corniche on SC-01 was straightforward, but the outdoor court had some maintenance issues. Value was acceptable, though I expected a bit more for the price. The booking platform worked fine, no glitches encountered.

Very pleased with the booking process at Baseline JVC for PC-04. The indoor panoramic court was excellent, worth every dirham. Slots were easy to find, and payment went smoothly. Highly recommend this branch for anyone looking for good value and convenience.

standard court 2 outdoor at baseline khalifa city is just right, no nonsense. courts are clean and firm, no complaints overall.

Baseline Al Quoz SC-02 outdoor court is fantastic! The court itself is well maintained and the open-air vibe is refreshing. Loved the easy parking and friendly staff who made the visit easy and pleasant. It’s perfect for both casual and competitive matches. A top spot for anyone looking to enjoy padel outside in a great setting!

Booking RC-03 at Baseline RAK Marina was smooth and user-friendly. The indoor court was clean and well maintained. Some minor scheduling delays were communicated promptly, so overall good value for the price!

Playing on PC-07 outdoor court at Baseline Al Quoz is generally pleasant. The panoramic views add a nice touch, and the overall ambiance is welcoming. A little more regular maintenance to ensure the court surface stays optimal would be appreciated. Nonetheless, a good spot for casual games and practice. Recommended.
baseline jvc pc-02 indoor court is perfect. clean, modern and well kept. very happy with this location overall.

Booking Panoramic Court 2 indoors at Baseline Khalifa was simple, & court conditions were as advertised. The pricing is sensible for the location. I had a minor delay in booking confirmation, though the staff quickly resolved it. Overall a positive experience.

Baseline Ajman Corniche’s outdoor SC-01 court coaching is generally good, with the coach offering strong fundamentals and game awareness tips. My only complaint would be the occasional lack of clear progression targets during sessions, which could help players track their improvements better overall.

The Baseline Al Quoz Panoramic Court 1 indoor provides excellent facilities, with great lighting and air conditioning. The booking process is smooth and the court was available early morning till late at night, which fit my schedule well. The staff were polite and ready to assist. Overall, a fantastic venue for both casual and more serious padel practice.
Baseline JVC SC-02 court was good but wind was an issue. Still enjoyed playing out there overall!

Booking the SC-01 court at Baseline Al Quoz was efficient and clear. The outdoor court was in good condition and the price felt fair for the quality provided. A good choice if you want a straightforward padel court reservation. Recommended.

baseline Al Quoz’s indoor PC-01, coached by Nicolas Prado, provides a great training environment. The facilities are top-notch and the coaching detailed. A few minutes more for warm-up space would put it ahead of similar clubs I’ve visited.

Standard Court 1 at Baseline Al Ain produced a mixed impression. While the staff were courteous, the court surface showed patches that affected play. Comparable clubs I've visited usually maintain more consistent conditions, so this was a downnote.

The Panoramic Court 1 (PC-01) indoor at Baseline Ajman Corniche is a solid place to practice. I appreciate the clean surroundings and the attentive staff. However, occasional scheduling conflicts do occur which can interfere slightly with my plans. Otherwise, it’s a good and reliable court for regular use overall.

Panoramic Court 2 indoor at Baseline JVC is easy to book, though the system prompt could be faster. Value is solid for indoor courts, and the experience was positive despite the small lag in communication during the booking.
Baseline Al Majaz’s outdoor SC-01 court offers an outstanding playing environment. The surface is excellent and the setting pleasant, making it one of the best outdoor venues I’ve visited for padel!

Booking SC-02 at Baseline Yas Island was user-friendly and quick. The court quality is good, providing a solid experience. Pricing seems fair for the facilities offered, creating a good balance between convenience and value. Recommended.

played at Baseline Khalifa City's indoor Panoramic Court 3 (PC-03) and had a great time! The court is super clean and has awesome lighting. Only tiny downside was a bit of waiting time, but overall, really enjoyed the vibe here!

Baseline Al Majaz offers a top-notch experience with its PC-02 indoor court. The panoramic views add a unique touch, enhancing every match. The lighting & court surface are excellent, allowing for consistent play. This branch has become my favorite spot for padel, combining comfort with a competitive atmosphere.
baseline yas island sc-03 outdoor was a mess when i played. court was slippery and slippery mats were not fixed. expected way better for this branch overall.

Baseline Al Ain’s SC-01 outdoor court presents a solid option for consistent practice. The court condition is good, though sometimes the weather affects playability. The atmosphere is generally welcoming, with other regulars sharing tips casually. While not perfect, it’s a reliable place that I’ve been happy to include in my routine over time.

I booked Standard Court 4 outdoors at Baseline Yas Island. The process was okay but felt somewhat cumbersome with unclear pricing during checkout. The court itself was fine. Not the worst experience, but the booking system could be clearer for first-timers!

Mixed feelings about coaching at Baseline Al Ain on SC-06 with Hamad Al Dhaheri. While he knows his stuff and is supportive, some sessions felt repetitive and lacked varied challenges. Progress is steady but I expected a bit more excitement and innovative drills to keep motivation higher. Recommended.

good coaching at Baseline Ajman Corniche on SC-04 outdoor. The coach offered effective technical advice, though the session started a bit late. Still, the outdoor environment and expert guidance made it worthwhile.

Enjoyed the PC-06 indoor court at Baseline Al Quoz coached by Tomas Aguirre. The weather outside was brisk but inside the temperature was just right. Tomas's coaching was insightful, helping me sharpen techniques. Only minor noise distractions from adjacent courts.

Playing on Panoramic Court 5 indoors at Baseline Al Quoz was a complete joy! The court surface is excellent and all equipment felt premium. The staff were professional and courteous. No complaints for a change—just top-level service and facilities here overall.

Coach Mariam Al Ameri at Baseline Al Ain on SC-03 was really knowledgeable and friendly. The outdoor standard court is a nice setting. I only gave 4 stars because some coaching points felt a little rushed, but overall, a satisfying and productive training session.
outdoor court sc-06 at baseline al ain is decent but maintenance lagging. had to wait for gear twice, not impressed!
baseline al quoz sc-02 outdoor is good as always. no frills but court quality and space are reliable for a decent game. Recommended.

my sessions with coach Noura Al Suwaidi at Baseline Al Majaz PC-02 have been a mixed bag. The coach is encouraging and has a nice teaching style, yet the indoor panoramic court felt a bit stuffy and the lighting wasn’t ideal during one of my visits. It’s a fine place for casual play but may not suit everyone.

The outdoor Panoramic Court 7 at Baseline Al Quoz coached by Tomas Aguirre is first-rate. Tomas provides insightful tips that dramatically enhanced my skills. The court enjoys wide-open views & is open from early morning to night, offering ample playtime. The lighting is excellent for night sessions. Overall, a stellar environment for focused training and casual fun alike.

The indoor session at Baseline Ajman Corniche on PC-01 was good overall. The coach provided solid advice, but sometimes the attention was split among several players which reduced the focus I expected. Still, the training atmosphere is positive and helpful overall.
baseline jvc pc-04 indoor court was flawless and really modern, really upped my game for sure.

My session at Baseline JVC’s outdoor Standard Court 1 with coach Miguel Santana had its ups and downs. Miguel was enthusiastic and provided solid tips, but the outdoor court surface was inconsistent, affecting ball control. Morning play was pleasant but limited shade made it uncomfortable as temperatures rose. The club environment was friendly though and the booking process straightforward. With some court upgrades, this would be a much stronger option!
